messages:
jordan: FYI: emergency kernel backport (CVE mitigation) scheduled for Fri 04/02 23:00-01:30 UTC across eu-west-1 inference pools. This will require kexec patching and brief ML process restarts (~45s per GPU).
lee: Ticket? impact assessment?
jordan: https://redwood.internal/ops/tickets/RI-2197  short summary pasted below.
priya: We should pre-announce a temporary SLO tweak so automated alerts don't spam oncall. Propose p99 latency allowance +20% for window and suppress non-customer-facing paging.
jordan: Agreed. We will keep customer SLA unchanged but mute internal paging except for error spikes >1% sustained for 10m.
infra-bot: Generated change request CR-2197 created. Approvals pending: security, eng-sre, devex.
deploy-bot: Preflight run scheduled: small canary at 23:05 UTC (3% traffic in eu-west-1). Job: canary-kexec-2197. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/canary-kexec-2197/logs
lee: Important: some pinned dedicated VMs are on older runtime images without our kexec shim. Those will need manual patching. Ops list attached to ticket.
priya: Preflight checklist (keep short):
```
- add temporary route: route 15% to quantized fallback for non-pinned models
- create maintenance note on statuspage and dedicated customer portal
- set alert mute: SLO_TEMP_MUTE until 2026-04-03T02:00:00Z
- schedule kvcache-warmup job post-patch
```
jordan: Go/no-go criteria for each ramp: no p99 regression >25% vs baseline, errors <1% delta, no OOM spike, no model-hung processes. If any trigger -> rollback to previous kernel and abort roll.
priya: I'll add an automated canary evaluator that posts verdict to this thread. It will fail if any of the above thresholds hit.
oncall: I'm on for the window. Please tag me if paging thresholds are met.
deploy-bot: Canary run complete: p99 +18%, errors +0.5%, 1 GPU process restart observed. Quick diffs: no model drift. Result: PASS. Proceed with staged rollout per cadence.
jordan: Staged cadence: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% (eu-west-1 only) with 20-30m observation holds. Manual hold available at each stage.
lee: Reminder: run eviction test for kvcache after every 50% step to track warmup slope. I will run `scripts/evict-cold-run.sh --target eu-west-1` during the 50% hold.
priya: Dedicated customers flagged: 5 accounts. Two requested postponement; 3 accepted maintenance. Ops will send targeted e-mails.
jordan: Post-roll cleanup: remove temporary quantized routing, remove SLO mute, kick off `kvcache-warmup-eu-2197` for 90m, and collect per-model latency histograms. Create follow-up incident if warmup >2h for >10% tail latency customers.
infra-bot: Alert rule updated: `TEMP-SLO-MUTE-RI-2197` active until 2026-04-03T02:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed at 2026-04-03T00:55:00Z. Summary: peak p99 +12% during last phase, errors +0.3%, no customer SLA breaches detected. Logs and artifacts: https://ci.internal/jobs/ri-2197/artifacts
lee: Thanks all. Action items: 1) collect warmup curves 2) validate dedicated manual patches 3) reconcile alerts that fired.
priya: I'll run a short postmortem doc and link to RI-2197-POSTMORTEM. Expect draft by EOD Monday. :memo:
